evidence_scope: Source-verified same-CR approval trace for Spec38.331. Original lexical Resolution ID DESC and ten pair-row cap select eight requested Resolution identities. The complete45-path/19-Resolution cutoff frontier is source-certified; independent SQL retains all160 qualified paths. Native execution returns ten rows with both requested identity and CR witness.
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10
question_en: Which resolutions approved the CRs that modify spec 38.331 (approval trace)?
reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'}) WHERE (r.content =~ ('(?ims).*^' + cr.tdocNumber + '\\t[^\\r\\n]*\\r?\\n(?:(?!R2-[0-9]{7}\\t)[^\\r\\n]*\\r?\\n)*?[ \\t]*(?:=>[ \\t]*)?(?:agreed(?:[ \\t]+in[ \\t]+principle)?|endorsed|approved|the[ \\t]+CR[ \\t]+is[ \\t]+agreed)(?=[ \\t.,!(;]|$)(?![^\\r\\n]*R2-[0-9]{7})[^\\r\\n]*(?:\\r?\\n.*)?') OR r.content =~ ('(?ims).*^[ \\t]*(?:=>[ \\t]*)?(?:agreed(?:[ \\t]+in[ \\t]+principle)?|endorsed|approved|the[ \\t]+CR[ \\t]+is[ \\t]+agreed)(?=[ \\t.,!(;]|$)[^\\r\\n]*' + cr.tdocNumber + '[^\\r\\n]*(?:\\r?\\n.*)?')) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId DESC LIMIT 10
